title: The King's Chamber shafts end horizontally

tellings.quote: The original archaeological documentation shows that the shafts go horizontal at the end.

plain: The narrow shafts that run from the King's Chamber, the main granite room inside the Great Pyramid, are said to turn flat at their outer ends instead of rising straight to the surface. The researcher Geoffrey Drumm says this on the show, pointing to 'the original archaeological documentation', which he says 'shows that the shafts go horizontal at the end', though he does not name which records he means or quote them. He raises it because it supports his view that the pyramid was built for a purpose other than a tomb.
